title: Being universally open is fppf local on the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that universal openness is fppf local on the source (statement lines 7084-7088). The proof shows both directions for an fppf covering {X_i -> X}: if f is universally open then so is each composite, because the covering maps are universally open and universal openness is preserved by composition; conversely, assuming each f_i universally open, one takes an arbitrary base change Y' -> Y, notes that the pulled-back family is again an fppf covering and that each pulled-back composite is open, and applies the corresponding locality lemma for openness to conclude that the base change of f is open, which is universal openness (proof lines 7090-7107). The level is H2: the argument is short but complete, with the reduction to the already-established openness statement made explicit.
